title: [0 of #7891] ADR-0091 seed pair crosses the publish door: `runtimeTypes: ['seed']` — measured trip-free first slice
body:
Programme slice of #7891 (split by the `domain:spec` seat, session `session_01Euoy6wyfzgiWtgCg4s6JK2`, per the triage note of 2026-08-12 sanctioning a `Blocked-by:`-ordered split). Independent — no `Blocked-by:`.

## Scope

One decision crossing the wall whole, per the parent card's own staging: register `runtimeTypes: ['seed']` for the ADR-0091 pair (`security-grant-expired-at-authoring`, `security-delegation-missing-reason`) so they enforce at the runtime publish door, plus the pin that records the crossing.

## Measured facts inherited from PR #7886 (re-run, do not trust)

- The pair reads only `stack.data[]`; the `seed → data` stack key was corrected under #7886.
- Trip-free on the shipped corpus (showcase + CRM + todo + blank): zero `error` findings at both surfaces.
- Re-check: `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` is the executable measurement.

## Constraints

- The whole sub-family crosses by this one decision — if measurement shows either rule now trips on the corpus, stop and report rather than exempting shapes ad hoc.
- ⛔ No partial `security-role-word` wiring smuggled in (parent card's #7220 constraint).

## Sequencing

⛔ Hold until #8116's PR merges — its dev is in flight in `packages/lint` (different files, same package; serialized by the seat to keep batches package-disjoint). Size S-mechanical once unblocked.

Part of #7891.
